title: Verify controlled descriptor batch importer calls
changes: Exercise the original encounter batch importer from entry through return using an authenticated two-unit descriptor-1 header and a retained ordinary-state context.
validation: Windows GNU build g8sp7nqz and Wine g2cugem4 passed five cases: limits 0, 1, 2 and 3 yielded 0, 1, 2 and 2 imported units; a separate limit-2 case skipped and preserved an occupied slot. Every expected row read was typed, raw and unclassified row reads were absent, and raw/managed state, clock, video, OAM and mixed audio matched at return. Inputs passed protection checks, scratch was removed and Wine drained.
limitations: Calls use synthetic destination occupancy and fixed input; ordinary batch-wrapper reachability, other headers and callers, per-read native attribution and other platforms remain open. Audio equality does not require nonempty audio.
